Commentary.Commentary: Right then! That is all we have from this game, but the action continues in the T20 World Cup. Up next, it's Sri Lanka vs Namibia in Group A. That one begins at 6 pm local time (2 pm GMT). Till then, take care and goodbye.

Curtis Campher is the MAN OF THE MATCH! Campher says that he just kept hitting the hard length and kept bowling on probing lines and lengths. Mentions that the skipper has faith in him and that helps a lot. Tells that he definitely heard some noise (On Ackermann's wicket) and says that he also knew that the ball was going to hit the stumps (On Edwards') wicket and therefore, they took the review.

The Irish skipper, Andy Balbirnie says that, it feels really good to get a win. Mentions that their bowling performance was really satisfying as a group and their batters did well to chase it down. Tells that they were pretty disciplined. Adds that Gareth Delany played the innings they wanted him to play and it was a comfortable chase in the end.

The captain of Netherlands, Pieter Seelaar says that, it wasn't the best Powerplay and the wicket was not as flat as they thought it would be. Adds that the bowlers did show some fight and defending such a total isn't easy. Mentions that the wicket did hold up a little bit and even in the first innings it wasn't easy to bat on. Adds that it's never easy to win three in a row and they'll make sure that they win the next one against Namibia.
... THE PRESENTATION CEREMONY ...

Earlier in the day, a hat-trick from Curtis Campher and some brilliant bowling from Mark Adair saw Netherlands being restricted to a really modest total. It proved to be a cake walk for the Irish batters as they chased down 107 runs with 29 balls left, on the back of a great innings from Gareth Delany. With ​​​​​this Ireland go top in Group A and have given a huge boost to their Super 12 qualification chances.

After a poor display with the bat, Netherlands only made things worse for themselves with the ball as they gave away 7 extras in the first over itself. However, their bowlers did keep things tight in the Powerplay and even picked up a couple of wickets. With a low score on the board, it required one good partnership and that is what Netherlands failed to break. Seelaar did stop Delany from reaching his half-century but it was a little too late for Netherlands to pull back things. Logan van Beek bowled well but didn't get a wicket while Seelaar, Klassen and Glover got one each. In the end they just didn't have runs on the board and were outclassed in all areas today.

Ireland will be so proud of their performance today as they finally got a win over Netherlands in the T20 World Cup. Kevin O'Brien and Paul Stirling started briskly and were helped by some early extras. O'Brien did throw his wicket away cheaply and the skipper, Balbirnie fell soon after. After this, Gareth Delany came in and looked positive right from the off. He put on a 59-run stand along with Paul Stirling and this put Ireland in pole position. Delany did fall but Stirling saw his team through by playing an anchor innings, which we rarely see from the big-hitter.

Ireland have made a statement with this win and have stamped their authority in this difficult group. An exceptional performance sees them wrap this one up with almost 5 overs to go, that'll help their net run-rate and Netherlands will be thoroughly disappointed with their performance.
That's it! There comes the winning runs! On the pads, Curtis Campher whips it to mid-wicket for a single. IRELAND WIN BY 7 WICKETS!
Pieter Seelaar (2-0-13-1) is back on.

FOUR! There comes the Paul Stirling we know! Logan van Beek dishes out a length ball, on off. Paul Stirling clears his front leg and whacks it over the bowler's head for a boundary. Scores are level now.
On a length on off, Paul Stirling presses forward and defends it solidly off the front foot.
Length ball, outside off. Paul Stirling defends it towards covers. This is very unline Stirling innings so far.
On middle, nudged to mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Short of a length, on off. Curtis Campher pulls it to deep mid-wicket. The fielder from deep square leg runs to his left but the ball wins the race. A boundary.
Fuller in length, on off. Curtis Campher squeezes it back to the bowler.
Logan van Beek is back on.
Tosses it up, on middle. Paul Stirling pushes it back to the bowler again.
Full and on middle, patted back to the bowler.
On middle, blocked out by Stirling.
Loopy ball, outside off. Curtis Campher slog-sweeps it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
On off, tapped on the off side.
Flighted ball, on off. Paul Stirling works it to sweeper cover for one.
Roelof van der Merwe to bowl his final over.
Loopy ball, outside off. Pushed towards covers.
Curtis Campher is the new man in.

OUT! TIMBER! A consolation wicket for Pieter Seelaar and Netherlands. Pieter Seelaar bowls it flatter and quicker, on off. Gareth Delany advances down the track and looks for another biggie but misses the ball completely. The ball rattles the stumps behind him and Gareth Delany has to depart. 12 needed from 43 balls now.
SIX! KABOOM! Tossed up delivery, on off. Gareth Delany goes down on one knee and sends the ball sailing over long on for a maximum. 86 metres strike that one!
Loopy ball, on off. Gareth Delany hangs back and pushes it to extra cover.
A low full toss on middle, clipped to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Tosses it up, outside off. Cut away to deep point for one.
Back of a length, around off. Delany plays it off the back foot, through the cover region and picks up a single.
There was a mid-pitch collision between Paul Stirling and Gareth Delany. Paul Stirling is being attended by the physio now. He seems okay and we are ready to resume.
A length ball, outside off and Delany leaves this one alone.

FOUR! Exquisite timing from Gareth Delany. Good-length ball, around off and this is caressed through the cover region for yet another boundary. The 50-run stand also comes up and just 21 required now off 50 balls.
FOUR! It's just too easy at the moment for Gareth Delany and Ireland. Banged in short but not short enough to trouble the batter. Delany clobbers it over mid-wicket and picks up a boundary.
Back of a length, outside off and steered to deep backward point for a single.
Fullish ball, outside off. Stirling dabs it down to cover-point.
Good-length ball, around off. This one whizzes past the outside edge as Gareth Delany looks to play at it.
Back of a length, Stirling hops and taps it on the off side for a single.
LEG BYE! Length again and Delany just walks across his tumps, looking to flick. He misses and the ball goes off the pads on the leg side. They get a leg bye.
On off and kept out by Delany.

FOUR! Poor fielding in the deep and that should have been cut off. Just short of a length and Gareth Delany pulls it through mid-wicket. The fielders from long on and deep mid-wicket converge but neither cuts it off. It's a boundary.

NOT OUT! A length ball, outside off. Paul Stirling taps it to backward and sets off for a quick single. The fielder scores a direct hit at the striker's end but Gareth Delany was well in. The third umpire signals the same on the big screen.

DRINKS! Ireland just need 37 runs now from the remaining 10 overs. They are in a strong position and it's only a matter of time before they chase down the target. Fred Klaassen (2-0-12-1) comes back into the attack.

FOUR! Roelof van der Merwe looks frustrated as Delany picks up another boundary off his bowling. Just outside the off pole and Delany cuts it really fine. The ball races away into the third man fence. 15 off the over!
WIDE! Fired in down the leg side. Wided.
Slowed up, on middle. Stirling defends it on the off side and gets another single as there is a huge gap around the cover region.
Quicker delivery, on off. Delany plays it with soft hands towards the cover-point region. They get an easy single.
On off and Stirling punches it on the off side for a single.
Roelof van der Merwe pulls back the length a bit, Delany cuts it behind point for a single. Smart batting.
SIX! Bang! Nicely tossed up, around off. Gareth Delany dances down the track and lifts this one well over the extra cover fence for a biggie.
Roelof van der Merwe is back into the attack.
A dot to end the over. Flighted ball, outside off. Stirling leans into the cover drive but can't get it through.
Seelaar bowls a round-arm delivery, quick and short, into the pads. Delany works it on the leg side for a single.
This is tossed up, on middle. Paul Stirling heaves it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Full, around off and driven down the ground for another single.
On middle and leg, pushed down to long on for a single.
Delany makes room but Seelaar bowls it slower. The ball holds into the surface a bit and Delany has to check his shot. He manages to get it down to long off for one.
On a length on off, Gareth Delany hooks it towards deep mid-wicket for a single. 50 up for Ireland!
Back of a length, outside off. Paul Stirling hangs back and cuts it towards deep backward point. He crosses ends.
Full and on middle and leg, Gareth Delany jams it out to mid on for a run.
On the pads, clipped to deep square leg for a single.
Length ball, outside off. Paul Stirling dabs it to backward point.
Good-length ball, wide outside off. Paul Stirling chases for it and slashes but misses.
Brandon Glover (1-0-7-1) is back into the attack.
FOUR! Nicely played! Full and wide outside off, Gareth Delany slaps that one powerfully through extra cover for a boundary.
Tosses it up, on off. Gareth Delany defends it to the off side.
Flighted ball on off, driven to long off for a single.
Slower through the air, on off. Gareth Delany chips it past the cover fielder for a run.
Full and on middle, pushed to mid-wicket for a single.
Darted on off, Gareth Delany looks to defend but gets an inside edge. The ball rolls to square leg for one.
Roelof van der Merwe (1-0-10-0) is brought back into the attack.
Length ball, outside off. Gareth Delany looks to drive but gets an outside edge. The ball goes to third man for a single.
Short on off, Delany on the backfoot looks to swipe across the line but misses, thuds high on the thigh in the end.
Back of a length, on middle. Delany gets behind the line and defends it back to the bowler.
Edge again! Length ball, outside off. Gareth Delany looks to drive but gets an outside edge. The ball falls just short of the first slip fielder.

Length ball, on off. Paul Stirling dances down the track and looks to lift it over covers. He gets an outside edge and the ball flies towards the right of the keeper. Scott Edwards dives that side but only gets his fingertips to it. The ball rolls to third man and the batters take one.
Good-length ball, on middle. Paul Stirling defends it right under his eyes.
Gareth Delany is the new man in. Also, Logan van Beek is back into the attack.

OUT! TAKEN! Fred Klaassen gets his man this time. He bowls another short-of-a-length delivery, on middle. Andy Balbirnie looks to go for the third boundary over mid-wicket. But doesn't manage to do so and pulls it straight to mid-wicket where Roelof van der Merwe is present. He takes a good catch moving to his right and Ireland lose their skipper.
Commentary.Howout: c Roelof van der Merwe b Fred Klaassen

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Excellent shot! Short of a length, on middle. Andy Balbirnie pulls it with disdain towards deep mid-wicket for another boundary.
FOUR! Width on offer, outside off. Andy Balbirnie opens the face of the bat and steers it towards the third man region for a boundary.
Fuller in length, on off. Andy Balbirnie pushes it towards mid off.
Length ball, on off. Andy Balbirnie drives it but finds the cover fielder.
Length ball, around off. Stirling tucks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Fred Klaassen (1-0-3-0) is back into the attack.
Short of a length, around off. Andy Balbirnie thumps it off the back foot to cover-point.
The skipper, Andy Balbirnie is in at number 3.

OUT! TAKEN! Netherlands get the breakthrough. Glover serves a short ball, outside off. Kevin O'Brien tries to ramp it away but mistimes it high in the air and towards covers where Logan van Beek takes a simple catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Logan van Beek b Brandon Glover

Commentary.Commentary: Short and outside off. Paul Stirling slaps it over covers. Just a single.
SIX! Paul Stirling has played this so well! A length ball, outside off. Paul Stirling opens the face of the bat, uses the pace of it and carves it over backward point for a biggie.
Again serves a full ball, on off. Paul Stirling blocks it on the off side.
A full ball, on middle, defended back to the bowler.
Change from both ends as Brandon Glover comes into the attack.
Short of a length, angling on middle. Kevin O'Brien ducks under it.
A length ball, outside off. Kevin O'Brien pushes it back to the bowler.
Slight fuller, on off. Kevin O'Brien makes room and bunts it to covers.
Full and outside off. Kevin O'Brien hits it on the off side.
On middle, on a length, flicked to deep square leg for a single.
A change in the attack straightaway as Logan van Beek comes on to bowl.
A length ball, on off. Paul Stirling pushes it through covers with soft hands and collects a couple.
Lovely shot but for a dot! A flatter ball, on off, pushed to point.
Sees Kevin O'Brien make room. Roelof van der Merwe serves it full and outside off, just inside the tramline.
Darted on the pads, flicked to mid-wicket for a single.
Around off, pushed down to long off for a single.
FOUR! Two in a row! Flatter and on middle. This time hits it all along the ground through covers for another boundary.
FOUR! First boundary off the bat! A full ball, on off. Kevin O'Brien clears his front leg and lofts it over covers for a boundary.
Roelof van der Merwe to bowl from the opposite end.
A length ball, outside off. Paul punches it to covers.
On a length, on off. Stirling blocks it on the off side.
WIDE! AGAIN! Sprays a full ball, down the leg side. Paul Stirling misses his flick. Wided.
A length ball, outside off. Paul Stirling looks to drive but misses.
WIDE! Length ball, way too outside off. Stirling leaves it alone. Wided.
FOUR BYES! This one bounced way up. A pacy short ball, outside off. Paul Stirling sees it sail over his head and over the keeper's head as well for a boundary.
Appeal for an LBW but turned down! An inswinger, full and on middle. Paul Stirling gets an inside edge as he looks to flick back on the pads.
WIDE! Ireland are off the mark. Spills it down the leg side. Left alone. Wide given.
Starts with a full ball, on off. Paul Stirling defends it to covers.
